title: On Elliptic Sequences over Commutative Rings
summary: We define elliptic sequences over a commutative ring as sequences indexed by the (positive) integers satisfying a 4-parameter, highly symmetric family of homogeneous quartic relations among terms which we call elliptic relations. We classify elliptic sequences over a field into three types, and show that most of them are dilated multiples of standard elliptic divisibility sequences (EDSs) which form countably many 4-dimensional families.
